title: Water Test
description: One pressure/flow test observation. A dynamic test records pressure at a measured flow; final hydraulic design requires at least one dynamic test (Agent Charter rule 3).

test_time.description: Local time of test, e.g. '07:30'. Pressure varies with system demand through the day.

method.description: How the test was performed, e.g. 'gauge on front hose bib', 'meter-based flow check', 'timed container'.

flow_gpm.description: Required for dynamic tests. Measured flow at which the pressure was observed.

other_demand_active.description: Whether other building/site demand was active during the test.
